title: heavy duty hangers
text: heavy duty hangers. These hangers are perfect for my yarn project. First, they are not quite as "heavy" or as wide as the ones available locally, however, that is why they are perfect for my project.  I want them to be a bit less thick.  Please look at the pics I have included for comparison.  I put a regular NOT heavy duty hanger next to these so you can get an idea of what you'll be getting.  They are for adult clothing in size... they are white... They are perfect for my project as the lighter weight hangers you buy in the stores any more have plastic "wings" at the corners which means I cannot cover them with yarn using my crochet method. These are a bit more money, but I think well worth it.  If you buy in larger quantity they are a few pennies less per hanger.  They were a bit loose in the box when they arrived, but they were all there and not damaged.  I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info comes up. Oh.  And I do NOT receive free or discounted products.
